guarantees.claim: Asynchronously resets alerts_q[0] to 0 when rst_ni is low.
Latch alerts[0] on every rising clock edge when not in reset, producing a one-cycle delayed copy.

uncertain_points.claim: If alerts[0] is a pulse, the register will capture a 1 and hold it indefinitely even after the alert source clears, creating a stuck alert.
uncertain_points.cond: alerts[0] pulse width < 1 clock cycle or latching before reset/deassertion
uncertain_points.risk: Permanent false alarm; loss of ability to distinguish recovered from active alert; potential denial of service or masking of subsequent alerts.

security_implications: The chunk latches a recoverable alert bit (alerts_q[0] from alerts[0]). If the alert source is a pulse, the register will hold the alert indefinitely even after recovery, leading to a stuck alarm that could cause unnecessary escalation or mask subsequent events. This undermines the alert handling mechanism and can affect system integrity monitoring.
